CATALOG_UNSERVABLE_TTL_SECONDS.description: Bounded-staleness backstop (seconds) for apistage catalog entries stored while their GVR informer is not servable. When > 0, such an entry self-evicts within this short TTL instead of the standard resolved-cache TTL. 0 disables (entries use the standard TTL).
CATALOG_UNSERVABLE_TTL_SECONDS.title: Catalog Unservable TTL Seconds

UAF_RESOLVED_TTL_SECONDS.description: Staleness bound (seconds) for restactions-class entries whose RESTAction declares a userAccessFilter stage (#118 (d)). When > 0, such an entry gets this short per-entry TTL instead of the standard resolved-cache TTL, capping how long an authorization change can be served stale; 0 disables. Scope limits: it bounds staleness over time, NOT identity, so it is not a mitigation for a cross-tenant key collision; and it stamps only the restactions class, not widgets or widgetContent. Inert in 1.12.3 because the A-1 mitigation declines every userAccessFilter-bearing cache write; load-bearing again in 1.13.0.
UAF_RESOLVED_TTL_SECONDS.title: UAF Resolved TTL Seconds

PRETTY_LOG.description: Emit ANSI multi-line pretty logs when true; one-line JSON when false. Set false in production.
PRETTY_LOG.title: Pretty Log

PHASE1_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Absolute outer backstop (seconds) for the whole Phase 1 warmup. With snowplow Fix 1b this is a backstop, not the primary bound.
PHASE1_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.title: Phase 1 Timeout Seconds

PHASE1_SYNC_PASS_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Per-pass grace (seconds) for one informer WaitForCacheSync pass; one stuck informer can stall at most this long, not the whole Phase 1 budget.
PHASE1_SYNC_PASS_GRACE_SECONDS.title: Phase 1 Sync Pass Grace Seconds

PHASE1_SYNC_QUIESCENCE_SECONDS.description: Registered informer-set stability window (seconds) after which the Phase 1 barrier returns good-enough, deferring still-unsynced informers to lazy-register fallthrough and the refresher.
PHASE1_SYNC_QUIESCENCE_SECONDS.title: Phase 1 Sync Quiescence Seconds

env.description: Env vars rendered into the chart's snowplow ConfigMap and consumed via envFrom.
env.title: Env

jwt.description: snowplow verifies RS256 JWTs issued by authn using authn's RSA public key, fetched from authn's JWKS endpoint (/.well-known/jwks.json) and cached. No key material is mounted: snowplow holds neither a private/signing key nor a copy of the public key, so rotating authn's keypair needs no snowplow redeploy. The key set is fetched lazily on first validation, not at startup, so snowplow does not depend on authn being up first.
jwt.title: JWT verification keys (JWKS)

jwksUrl.description: Full JWKS URL. Empty derives it from URL_AUTHN as <URL_AUTHN>/.well-known/jwks.json; set only to point at a different authn.
jwksUrl.title: JWKS URL

cacheTTL.description: How long a fetched key set is served before it is refreshed (Go duration, e.g. "5m").
cacheTTL.title: JWKS cache TTL

minRefreshInterval.description: Minimum gap between two JWKS fetch attempts (Go duration, e.g. "30s"). Throttles the refetch an unknown "kid" triggers so it cannot become one fetch per request.
minRefreshInterval.title: JWKS minimum refresh interval

requestTimeout.description: Timeout for a single JWKS fetch (Go duration, e.g. "5s"). Also bounds how long a token validation can block.
requestTimeout.title: JWKS request timeout

seedAuthn.description: #57 prewarm seed→authn loopback-token artifacts (projected audience=authn SA token + authn ServiceAccount allowlist CR + seed-group ClusterRole/Binding). Default off; enabling requires the authn operator's serviceaccount.authn.krateo.io CRD.
seedAuthn.title: Seed Authn
